_comment: Bible versions players can choose. Country > language > version. A version lists its TEXT filesets: 'filesets' has one fileset for the Old Testament (OT) and one for the New Testament (NT), or a single complete fileset under 'C'. Set enabled to true to download it at build time (DOWNLOAD_TEXT=true). scope: 'games' downloads only the chapters the games use (game-chapters.json); 'full' downloads the whole Bible.
